title: Updating marketplace listings with a cache and search index
name: Listing update service

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code keeps cached and indexed listings consistent with the database? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client calls update with tags ["Vintage", "vintage", "Lamp"]. What tags end up in the document saved to the primary?
choices: The previous tags, since tags are only replaced when empty

questions.prompt: Why does update read the existing listing from primary rather than replica?
choices: The replica does not implement save
Reads from the primary are cached longer
So the patch is merged onto the latest committed version, avoiding overwriting a recent write with older fields
Because the replica throws ListingNotFound for new listings

questions.prompt: The cache is unreachable and cache.get rejects. What happens on a call to get?
choices: It falls back to the replica and returns the document
It retries the cache once and then reads the primary
The call rejects with the cache error
